create_Point_message: create a Point protobuf message with latitude and longitude coordinates for route guide
create_Rectangle_message: create a Rectangle protobuf message with lo and hi Point bounds for feature queries
create_Feature_message: create a Feature protobuf message with a name and location Point for route guide data
create_RouteNote_message: create a RouteNote protobuf message with a location Point and message string for chat
create_RouteSummary_message: create a RouteSummary protobuf message with point_count, feature_count, distance, and elapsed_time
